text:
Ashley: Heads-up: PR 23611 is blocked on CI. Integration job on linux-pool keeps failing with a port bind error during service startup. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/23611 :eyes:
Ashley: Log excerpt:
```
--- FAIL: TestDockerNetworkSetup
error: listen tcp 0.0.0.0:8080: bind: address already in use
setup: failed to start service: exit status 1
```
Ashley: This only happens on the linux/container runners; macos and windows runners pass. I can't reproduce locally with docker-for-desktop. Anyone seen this before?
Chris: Hmm, looks like a flaky port collision on the runner host. Could be leftover process from previous job or ephemeral port map race. :thinking_face:
Chris: Two quick asks: can you try a targeted rerun first? if it flakes again we should force a different port in the test or add an exponential backoff to the setup.
Ashley: Kicking a rerun now. If it fails again I'll push a small test fix changing bind to 0 (auto) + retry.
ci-bot: buildkite: Re-run requested by Ashley for PR 23611 — job queued (#int-integ-linux)
Devon: Thanks — if you push a fix that changes ports, add a short comment linking the CI flakes ticket so we don't accidentally mask a real networking regression.
Maria: If we end up changing the test to use ephemeral ports, please avoid hardcoding 8080 in other test helpers. I ran into a similar issue last quarter.
Ashley: Agreed. I'll prepare a tiny patch that picks an available port and retries 3x with 200ms backoff. Will include a link to the CI issue and a note in the PR description.
ci-bot: buildkite: Re-run started (job id 7823) — live logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/integration/builds/7823
Chris: If rerun passes, can someone approve? We need to get this merged before tomorrow's release window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon: I can give an approval once the rerun passes and Ashley adds the flaky test note.
Maria: I'll watch the build and give a quick review for the change.
ci-bot: buildkite: Job succeeded (7823) — all integration checks green
Ashley: Rerun succeeded. Pushing the small port/retry patch now, will ping for review when it's up. :shipit:
Devon: Great, thanks. Once PR has the change and a brief testing note I will approve.
Ashley: Update: pushed patch and added CI issue link. @Devon could you take a look when you have a sec?
Devon: On it, should be quick.
Maria: LGTM from me on the test change.
Devon: Approved.
Ashley: Thanks all — merging now. :tada:
